028/**
029 * Convenience static methods for serializing objects with all supported Juneau marshalling formats.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Designed for use with static imports to allow concise serialization code without explicitly
033 * referencing marshaller classes.
034 *
035 * <h5 class='figure'>Examples:</h5>
036 * <p class='bjava'>
037 *    <jk>import static</jk> org.apache.juneau.marshall.marshaller.MarshallUtils.*;
038 *
039 *    <jc>// Serialize — char-based formats return String.</jc>
040 *    String <jv>a</jv> = json(<jv>myBean</jv>);
041 *    String <jv>b</jv> = json5(<jv>myBean</jv>);
042 *    String <jv>c</jv> = xml(<jv>myBean</jv>);
043 *    String <jv>d</jv> = html(<jv>myBean</jv>);
044 *    String <jv>e</jv> = yaml(<jv>myBean</jv>);
045 *
046 *    <jc>// Serialize — write to a stream.</jc>
047 *    json(<jv>myBean</jv>, myWriter);
048 *
049 *    <jc>// Serialize — binary formats return byte[].</jc>
050 *    <jk>byte</jk>[] <jv>f</jv> = msgPack(<jv>myBean</jv>);
051 *    <jk>byte</jk>[] <jv>g</jv> = cbor(<jv>myBean</jv>);
052 *
053 *    <jc>// Parse — same method names, overloaded by input type.</jc>
054 *    MyBean <jv>b1</jv> = json(<jv>jsonString</jv>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
055 *    MyBean <jv>b2</jv> = xml(<jv>xmlString</jv>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
056 *    MyBean <jv>b3</jv> = msgPack(<jv>bytes</jv>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
057 *
058 *    <jc>// Parse — parameterized types.</jc>
059 *    List&lt;MyBean&gt; <jv>list</jv> = json(<jv>jsonString</jv>, List.<jk>class</jk>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
060 * </p>
061 *
062 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
063 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/Marshallers">Marshallers</a>
064 * </ul>
065 */
066@SuppressWarnings({
067   "java:S6539" // Monster class; MarshallUtils is intentionally a single cohesive terse-marshalling-facade hub, one method family per format
068})
069public final class MarshallUtils {
070
071   private MarshallUtils() {}

077   /**

079    *
080    * <p>
081    * A shortcut for calling <c>Json.<jsm>of</jsm>(<jv>object</jv>)</c>.
082    *
083    * @param object The object to serialize.
084    * @return The serialized object.
085    * @throws SerializeException If a problem occurred trying to convert the output.

087   public static String json(Object object) throws SerializeException {
088      return Json.of(object);
089   }

1862    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
1863    * @param o The BSON input bytes.
1864    * @param c The object type to create.
1865    * @return The parsed object.
1866    */
1867   public static <T> T bson(byte[] o, Class<T> c) {
1868      return safe(() -> Bson.to(o, c));
1869   }

1871   /**
1872    * Parses BSON bytes to the specified parameterized Java type.
1873    *
1874    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
1875    * @param input The BSON input bytes.
1876    * @param type The object type to create.
1877    * @param args The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
1878    * @return The parsed object.
1879    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
1880    */
1881   public static <T> T bson(byte[] input, Type type, Type... args) throws ParseException {
1882      return Bson.to(input, type, args);
1883   }

1885   /**
1886    * Serializes a Java object to Apache Parquet bytes.
1887    *
1888    * <p>
1889    * A shortcut for calling <c>Parquet.<jsm>of</jsm>(<jv>object</jv>)</c>.
1890    *
1891    * <p class='warnbox'>
1892    *    <b>Note:</b> Parquet is collection-oriented. A single bean is automatically wrapped in a one-element list.
1893    * </p>
1894    *
1895    * @param object The object to serialize (Collection, array, or single bean).
1896    * @return The serialized object.
1897    * @throws SerializeException If a problem occurred trying to convert the output.
1898    */
1899   public static byte[] parquet(Object object) throws SerializeException {
1900      return Parquet.of(object);
1901   }
1902
1903   /**
1904    * Serializes a Java object to the specified Parquet output.
1905    *
1906    * @param object The object to serialize.
1907    * @param output The output object (OutputStream or File).
1908    * @return The output object.
1909    * @throws SerializeException If a problem occurred trying to convert the output.
1910    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
1911    */
1912   public static Object parquet(Object object, Object output) throws SerializeException, IOException {
1913      Parquet.DEFAULT.write(object, output); return output;
1914   }

1916   /**
1917    * Parses a Parquet input to a list of the specified Java type.
1918    *
1919    * <p class='warnbox'>
1920    *    <b>Note:</b> Parquet always returns a {@link List}; the parser never returns a bare instance.
1921    * </p>
1922    *
1923    * @param <T> The element type.
1924    * @param input The input (InputStream, byte[], or File).
1925    * @param type The bean class (parser returns {@code List<T>}).
1926    * @return The parsed list of beans.
1927    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
1928    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
1929    */
1930   @SuppressWarnings({
1931      "unchecked" // Parquet always returns List<T>; generic cast is safe by contract.
1932   })
1933   public static <T> List<T> parquet(Object input, Class<T> type) throws ParseException, IOException {
1934      return (List<T>) Parquet.DEFAULT.read(input, List.class, type);
1935   }
